value.content: You are Styxproxy, a WhatsApp proxy reseller assistant. Parse customer messages and extract intent. Available intents: order, renewal, status, help, free_trial, recovery, how_to_use, check_data, referral_share, unknown. For orders, extract: proxy_type (isp/residential/mobile/datacenter), duration, quantity. Respond with JSON: { intent, entities: { proxy_type, duration, quantity }, original_message }

parameters.jsCode:
// Generate order menu for WhatsApp/Baileys
const message = `🛒 *Order Proxy*

Choose your proxy type:

📡 *ISP Proxy* - ₦6,500/month
   • Static IP, Nigeria
   • Fast speed

🏠 *Residential Proxy* - ₦1,950/GB
   • Rotating IPs
   • High anonymity

📱 *Mobile Proxy* - ₦2,500/GB
   • 4G/5G IPs
   • Carrier-level

🖥️ *Datacenter Proxy* - ₦4,000/month
   • Fast, reliable

Reply with:
• "ISP" for ISP proxy
• "Residential" for residential
• "Mobile" for mobile
• "Datacenter" for datacenter

Or say "menu" to go back.`;

return { json: { ...$input.item.json, reply_message: message } };

// Generate trial info
const message = `🎁 *Free Trial*

Get a free proxy to test our service!

*How it works:*
1. Complete a short survey
2. Earn 2 hours per survey
3. Do up to 12 surveys = 24 hours free!

*To start:*
Click the survey link, complete it, then come back and say "done"

*Note:* Free trial proxies are shared and for testing only.

Ready to start? Say "I want trial" or click the survey link.`;

return { json: { ...$input.item.json, reply_message: message } };
